signaturePolicy.scope: Observed accepted NativeWeave.HelloWorld preview.5.1 and preview.6.1 repository-primary signatures. A certificate rotation or author/countersign route requires a separately reviewed policy and tests. This test policy does not enable or modify repository release workflows.

limits: No current main, publication or public consumption success is asserted by this preparation.
The release uses module-separated records, so its automatic public run normally proves each standalone package, not a combined public two-package application.

Actual temporary NuGet.Config/project.assets may not be retained by existing artifact recipe. Public-source/cache isolation is then established from exact source+--public invocation plus package hash linkage, not an invented retained config.
GitHub artifact/log absence, indexing pending, skipped publication or partial receipts remain incomplete rather than green-credit.
No workflow dispatch, CI edit, package push, local build, benchmark or Go draft mutation is authorized for this reader.
